  > *"We are Respired.io, Corp. ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' 'our'), a company registered in Lewes, Delaware, United States. We operate the website www.respired.io (the 'Site'), the mobile application app.respired.io (the 'App'), as well as any other related products and services..."*
* **Privacy Policy (`respired.io`):**  
  > *"This privacy notice for Respired.io, Corp. ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'), describes how and why we might collect, store, use, and/or share ('process') your information when you use our services ('Services'), such as when you: Visit our website at http://www.respired.io..."*
* **Website Footer (`respired.io`):**  
  > *"© Mora AI (formerly respired.io, Corp.) - All Rights Reserved."*
